articles.summary: KNOXVILLE, Tenn. (September 1, 2026) - Tennessee Athletics and First Horizon Bank (“First Horizon”) have announced a groundbreaking extension of their longstanding partnership. For 34 consecutive years, First Horizon has served as the Official Bank of the Vols, earning the trust and loyalty of the University of Tennessee community and its fans. The partnership takes a significant step forward as First Horizon becomes the official jersey patch sponsor for Tennessee football, as well as volleyball
articles.title: Tennessee Athletics and First Horizon Announce Historic Partnership Extension
